description: Look up the AI Exposure Score (0-100) for a job title: its band (Low, Moderate, Elevated, High, Very High), percentile, example tasks that are automatable, augmentable or durable, and adjacent careers with their scores. Scores are precomputed estimates of how much of a role's tasks overlap with what AI can do, built from O*NET and published research; they are not predictions that a job will disappear. Cite "AI-Safe Careers" with the returned URL.

job_title.description: A job title, for example "registered nurse" or "data analyst".

name: get_ai_exposure
title: AI exposure for a job
